sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.zh: 拉加德、佐兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.

sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: Federal prosecutors are asking a court to throw out their own criminal case against former National
sentences.zh: 联邦检察官正请求法院撤销他们对前国家安全顾问

sentences.en: Security Advisor Michael Flynn.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·弗林的刑事诉讼。

sentences.en: Mark Mazzetti on what led to that decision.
sentences.zh: 马克·马泽蒂将讲述导致这一决定的原因。

sentences.en: It's Thursday,
sentences.zh: 今天是周四，

sentences.en: May 14th.
Mark, remind us where the Michael Flynn story starts.
sentences.zh: 马克，提醒一下我们迈克尔·弗林的故事是从哪里开始的。

sentences.en: Michael Flynn was a three-star Army general who had a quite distinguished career, became the head of the Defense Intelligence Agency under the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·弗林曾是一位三星陆军中将，职业生涯相当显赫，在奥巴马政府时期担任过国防情报局局长。

sentences.en: And then he gradually sort of moves into the Trump orbit in 2016 when Trump was running for president during the Republican convention.
sentences.zh: 后来，他在2016年特朗普竞选总统期间，在共和党大会上逐渐进入了特朗普的圈子。

sentences.en: We do not need a reckless president who believes she is above the law.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要一位认为自己凌驾于法律之上的鲁莽总统。

sentences.en: He famously leads a chant.
sentences.zh: 他最出名的事迹是带领大家高呼口号。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Lock her up.
sentences.zh: 把她关起来。

sentences.en: Lock her up, meaning to Hillary Clinton.
sentences.zh: “把她关起来”，指的是希拉里·克林顿。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If I did a tenth of what she did, I would be in jail today.
sentences.zh: 如果我做了她所做之事的十分之一，我今天就会在监狱里了。

sentences.en: And after Trump is elected, he announces that he's going to make Flynn his national security advisor.
sentences.zh: 特朗普当选后，他宣布将任命弗林为国家安全顾问。

sentences.en: So it's during this time when there's a series of events that get Michael Flynn into trouble.
sentences.zh: 正是在这段时间里，发生了一系列事件，让迈克尔·弗林陷入了麻烦。

sentences.en: It's shortly after Christmas in 2016 when the Obama administration announces a number of sanctions against Russia for its efforts to sabotage the 2016 campaign.
sentences.zh: 2016年圣诞节后不久，奥巴马政府宣布对俄罗斯实施一系列制裁，以回应其破坏2016年竞选活动的企图。

sentences.en: It was soon after that.
sentences.zh: 就在那之后不久。

sentences.en: The Washington Post reports that Trump's incoming national security advisor, Michael Flynn, repeatedly called the Russian ambassador to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》报道称，特朗普即将上任的国家安全顾问迈克尔·弗林多次致电俄罗斯驻美大使。

sentences.en: that the Washington Post reported that Flynn had been on a number of phone calls with the Russian ambassador.
sentences.zh: 《华盛顿邮报》报道称，弗林曾与俄罗斯大使通过多次电话。

sentences.en: On the exact same day.
sentences.zh: 就在同一天。

sentences.en: On the same day, the Obama sanctions were announced, which raised questions about whether the incoming Trump administration was trying to meddle
sentences.zh: 就在奥巴马宣布制裁的同一天，这引发了人们的质疑：特朗普即将上任的政府是否试图干预

sentences.en: with the Obama administration's foreign policy.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马政府的外交政策。

sentences.en: I talked to General Flynn about that conversation and actually...
sentences.zh: 我和弗林将军谈过那次谈话，实际上……

sentences.en: Vice President-elect Mike Pence goes on face the nation.
sentences.zh: 当选副总统迈克·彭斯参加了《面向全国》节目。

sentences.en: They did not discuss anything having to do with the United States' decision to impose a censure against
sentences.zh: 他们没有讨论任何与美国决定对

sentences.en: Russia.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯实施制裁有关的事情。

sentences.en: So did they ever have...
sentences.zh: 那么他们到底有没有……

sentences.en: Pence says that Flynn had told him that sanctions never came up on the call.
sentences.zh: 彭斯说，弗林告诉他，通话中从未提及制裁。

sentences.en: The Justice Department had transcripts of the calls in which Flynn had actually urged the ambassador not to overreact to the Obama administration's sanctions.
sentences.zh: 司法部掌握了通话记录，记录显示弗林实际上曾敦促大使不要对奥巴马政府的制裁反应过度。

sentences.en: FBI agents interviewed Michael Flynn about whether he discussed U.S.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局特工就迈克尔·弗林是否讨论过美国

sentences.en: sanctions with Russia...
sentences.zh: 对俄制裁一事对他进行了讯问……

sentences.en: So FBI agents are sent to the White House to interview Flynn.
sentences.zh: 所以联邦调查局特工被派往白宫讯问弗林。

sentences.en: What has he told investigators?
sentences.zh: 他告诉调查人员什么了？

sentences.en: He tells them that the sanctions never came up on the call.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们，通话中从未提及制裁。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's lying to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 他在对联邦调查局撒谎。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This all becomes public.
sentences.zh: 这一切都公开了。

sentences.en: And in February 2017...
General Michael Flynn suddenly resigned late last night.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·弗林将军昨晚突然辞职。

sentences.en: Flynn is forced to resign.
sentences.zh: 弗林被迫辞职。

sentences.en: He is the shortest serving national security advisor now in modern history.
sentences.zh: 他现在是现代史上任职时间最短的国家安全顾问。

sentences.en: And what happens to Flynn once he's pushed out of the White House?
sentences.zh: 弗林被赶出白宫后发生了什么？

sentences.en: The FBI continues to investigate Flynn, but very little is heard from him for a number of months.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局继续调查弗林，但几个月来几乎没有他的消息。

sentences.en: And during this time, President Trump starts leaning on James Comey, the FBI director, in essence, to drop the Flynn investigation.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，特朗普总统开始向联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米施压，本质上是要求他放弃对弗林的调查。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that raised this idea that the President of the United States was trying to obstruct justice.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一种观点，即美国总统试图妨碍司法公正。

sentences.en: And that's this kind of cataclysmic moment that ultimately sets off a chain of events that leads to not only Comey being fired,
sentences.zh: 这是一种灾难性的时刻，最终引发了一连串事件，不仅导致科米被解雇，

sentences.en: but also the appointment of Mueller as the special counsel.
sentences.zh: 还导致了穆勒被任命为特别检察官。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In many ways, the Flynn saga is the beginning of the Mueller saga and the beginning of a very dark chapter for the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，弗林传奇是穆勒传奇的开始，也是特朗普政府非常黑暗篇章的开始。

sentences.en: That's correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What ends up happening to Michael Flynn?
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·弗林最终怎么样了？

sentences.en: Well...
Flynn pled guilty to repeatedly lying to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 弗林承认多次对联邦调查局撒谎。

sentences.en: Flynn ends up pleading guilty to lying to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 弗林最终承认对联邦调查局撒谎。

sentences.en: He is cooperating with the...
sentences.zh: 他正在与……合作。

sentences.en: Becomes a cooperating witness in the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 成为穆勒调查中的合作证人。

sentences.en: Flynn is a waiting sentence.
sentences.zh: 弗林正在等待判决。

sentences.en: Court documents make clear that Flynn was not acting alone.
sentences.zh: 法庭文件清楚地表明，弗林并非独自行动。

sentences.en: And the significance was that he was the first top White House official to plead guilty as part of the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 其重要性在于，他是穆勒调查中第一位认罪的白宫高级官员。

sentences.en: Court papers say Flynn could get up to six months behind bars, but he was...
sentences.zh: 法庭文件称弗林可能面临最高六个月的监禁，但他……

sentences.en: Mark, I feel like for many people, that is where the Michael Flynn story pretty much ends, right?
sentences.zh: 马克，我觉得对很多人来说，迈克尔·弗林的故事到这里基本就结束了，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, you have this three-star general, national security advisor, who totally falls from grace after lying to his bosses and the FBI, and now he's headed to prison.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你有一位三星将军、国家安全顾问，在对老板和联邦调查局撒谎后彻底失势，现在他要进监狱了。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the Mueller investigation marches on.
sentences.zh: 而穆勒的调查仍在继续。

sentences.en: And the next significant point is the end of 2018 into 2019, when Flynn is set sentence by a federal judge.
sentences.zh: 下一个重要节点是2018年底到2019年初，当时弗林即将被联邦法官判刑。

sentences.en: And the Mueller team weighs in.
sentences.zh: 穆勒团队发表了意见。

sentences.en: Breaking news right now.
sentences.zh: 突发新闻。

sentences.en: Bob Mueller's office is recommending to the judge that Michael Flynn actually not receive any prison time.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃·穆勒的办公室建议法官，迈克尔·弗林实际上不应接受任何监禁。

sentences.en: And says Flynn's been a good witness.
sentences.zh: 并称弗林一直是个好证人。

sentences.en: Michael Flynn cooperated plenty with the special counsel.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·弗林与特别检察官进行了充分的合作。

sentences.en: They recommend very little, if any, jail time.
sentences.zh: 他们建议判处极短的刑期，甚至不判监禁。

sentences.en: The defendant provided firsthand information about the content and context of interactions between the transition team and Russian government officials.
sentences.zh: 被告提供了关于过渡团队与俄罗斯政府官员之间互动的内容和背景的第一手信息。

sentences.en: And something curious happens then, where Flynn's legal team, which had been very cooperative towards the Mueller investigation,
sentences.zh: 然后发生了一件奇怪的事情，弗林的法律团队，此前一直对穆勒的调查非常配合，

sentences.en: clearly they kind of seem to be a pretty good deal with the Mueller team, decides to take a more combative stance.
sentences.zh: 显然他们似乎与穆勒团队达成了相当不错的协议，却决定采取更具对抗性的立场。

sentences.en: They enter into the public record this idea that maybe Flynn had been railroaded, that the FBI may have set him up.
sentences.zh: 他们向公众记录提交了一种观点，即弗林可能被陷害了，联邦调查局可能设局陷害了他。

sentences.en: So, this angers the judge.
sentences.zh: 这激怒了法官。

sentences.en: He really reads Flynn and his team the riot act, saying, you know, are you now saying you're not remorseful?
sentences.zh: 他严厉斥责了弗林及其团队，说，你是说你现在没有悔意吗？

sentences.en: And why are you now accusing the FBI of misconduct?
sentences.zh: 为什么你现在指责联邦调查局有不当行为？

sentences.en: And basically says, let's take a pause.
sentences.zh: 基本上他说，让我们暂停一下。

sentences.en: We're going to put this off for a few months.
sentences.zh: 我们要把这件事推迟几个月。

sentences.en: And come back to me when you've found some remorse.
sentences.zh: 等你找到悔意后再回来找我。

sentences.en: In the intervening time, the ground starts to shift.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，局势开始发生变化。

sentences.en: William Barr has just been sworn in as the new attorney general, gaining broad control of the special counsel Robert Mueller's Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 威廉·巴尔刚刚宣誓就任新任司法部长，获得了对特别检察官罗伯特·穆勒俄罗斯调查的广泛控制权。

sentences.en: William Barr takes over as attorney general.
sentences.zh: 威廉·巴尔接任司法部长。

sentences.en: I believe it is vitally important that the special counsel be allowed to complete his investigation.
sentences.zh: 我相信让特别检察官完成他的调查至关重要。

sentences.en: He, during his confirmation hearing, pledges that he's not going to interfere with the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 他在确认听证会上承诺，不会干预穆勒的调查。

sentences.en: So, Mueller famously then delivers his report to Barr in March of 2019.
sentences.zh: 因此，穆勒在2019年3月向巴尔提交了他的报告。

sentences.en: The deputy attorney general and I concluded that the evidence developed by the special counsel is not sufficient to establish that the president committed an obstruction of justice offense.
sentences.zh: 副司法部长和我得出结论，特别检察官收集的证据不足以证明总统犯有妨碍司法公正罪。

sentences.en: And Barr writes a very short summary of sorts that he says summarizes Mueller's findings, which we now know misinterprets the Mueller report.
sentences.zh: 巴尔写了一份非常简短的总结，他说这是对穆勒调查结果的总结，但我们现在知道这曲解了穆勒报告。

sentences.en: It's quite clear, starting at that point, that Barr has great issues with not only the Mueller investigation, but how this all began,
sentences.zh: 很明显，从那时起，巴尔不仅对穆勒的调查有很大意见，而且对这一切是如何开始的，

sentences.en: how the Russia investigation began at the FBI and whether there was real misconduct.
sentences.zh: 俄罗斯调查在联邦调查局是如何开始的，以及是否存在真正的不当行为，都有很大意见。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I've been trying to get answers to questions, and I found that a lot of the answers have been inadequate.
sentences.zh: 我一直在试图得到问题的答案，但我发现很多答案都不充分。

sentences.en: So, he makes no secret of the fact that he's going to start investigating the investigators.
sentences.zh: 所以，他毫不掩饰自己将开始调查调查人员的事实。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He is going to launch a campaign to get to the bottom of what happened and whether there really was a political effort to go after Donald J.
sentences.zh: 他将发起一场运动，查明到底发生了什么，以及是否真的存在针对唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump and his advisors.
sentences.zh: 特朗普及其顾问的政治行动。

sentences.en: And what does that mean for Michael Flynn awaiting sentencing for lying to the FBI?
sentences.zh: 这对等待因对联邦调查局撒谎而判刑的迈克尔·弗林意味着什么？

sentences.en: As the ground shifts and as it's clear that Barr is going to look at the predicate for the entire investigation, Flynn decides to get a new lawyer.
sentences.zh: 随着局势的变化，随着巴尔显然要审查整个调查的前提，弗林决定聘请一位新律师。

sentences.en: Nothing about this case was done right.
sentences.zh: 这个案子没有一点是做得对的。

sentences.en: They violated every rule, every protocol.
sentences.zh: 他们违反了每一条规则，每一个程序。

sentences.en: Who is not only a lawyer, but also a pundit of sorts.
sentences.zh: 她不仅是一位律师，也是一位评论员。

sentences.en: But the entire prosecution was false.
sentences.zh: 但整个起诉都是虚假的。

sentences.en: It must be dismissed.
sentences.zh: 必须驳回。

sentences.en: This is a Texas lawyer named Sidney Powell who has made no secret of the fact that she thinks the entire thing is a witch hunt.
sentences.zh: 这是一位名叫西德尼·鲍威尔的德克萨斯州律师，她毫不掩饰自己认为这一切都是一场政治迫害。

sentences.en: Their prosecution of General Flynn was needed to keep the obstruction hoax going against the president because they already knew the Russia hoax had fallen apart.
sentences.zh: 起诉弗林将军是为了维持针对总统的“妨碍司法骗局”，因为他们已经知道“俄罗斯骗局”已经破产了。

sentences.en: Very much in line with what the president of the United States has said.
sentences.zh: 这与美国总统所说的话非常一致。

sentences.en: So the whole thing was orchestrated and set up within the FBI.
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都是在联邦调查局内部策划和设置的。

sentences.en: And days before she takes over as Flynn's lawyer, she writes a secret letter to Attorney General Barr where she writes, quote,
sentences.zh: 在她接手弗林律师职务的前几天，她写了一封秘密信件给司法部长巴尔，她在信中写道，引用：

sentences.en: it is increasingly apparent that General Flynn was targeted and taken out of the Trump administration for concocted and political purposes.
sentences.zh: 越来越明显的是，弗林将军是被针对的，并因捏造和政治目的被从特朗普政府中清除。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So you're saying Flynn recognizes the winds are changing, recognizing that there's literally a new sheriff, attorney general in town,
sentences.zh: 所以你是说弗林意识到风向正在转变，意识到真的来了一位新的司法部长，

sentences.en: who's skeptical of the entire Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 他对整个俄罗斯调查持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: And so Flynn hires a lawyer who fits quite nicely into that dynamic.
sentences.zh: 所以弗林聘请了一位非常符合这种动态的律师。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And during that period of time,
sentences.zh: 在那段时间里，

sentences.en: Attorney General Barr decides to appoint another prosecutor who's going to examine the case and see whether there had been any misconduct that had taken place.
sentences.zh: 司法部长巴尔决定任命另一位检察官，他将审查此案，看看是否发生了任何不当行为。

sentences.en: So just to be clear, in addition to examining the roots of the Russia investigation broadly,
sentences.zh: 所以明确一下，除了广泛审查俄罗斯调查的根源外，

sentences.en: Barr appoints a specific prosecutor inside the Department of Justice just to examine the Flynn case.
sentences.zh: 巴尔在司法部内部任命了一名专门的检察官来审查弗林案。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that leads to the release of a number of documents to the public in recent weeks that have led both Flynn's lawyers and the president to make the case that Michael Flynn was indeed railroaded and set up by the FBI.
sentences.zh: 这导致最近几周向公众发布了大量文件，这些文件促使弗林的律师和总统都提出迈克尔·弗林确实是被联邦调查局陷害和设局的说法。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Mark, tell us what's inside these documents.
sentences.zh: 马克，告诉我们这些文件里有什么。

sentences.en: In essence, the documents are internal FBI and Justice Department communications around the time that Flynn was interviewed by the FBI.
sentences.zh: 本质上，这些文件是弗林接受联邦调查局讯问期间，联邦调查局和司法部内部的通信记录。

sentences.en: And what they show kind of broadly are that there was concern about the decision to interview Flynn.
sentences.zh: 它们广泛地显示出，当时对讯问弗林的决定存在担忧。

sentences.en: One of the documents that got a lot of attention was written by Bill Priestap, who at the time was the head of the FBI's counterintelligence division,
sentences.zh: 其中一份引起广泛关注的文件是由比尔·普里斯特普撰写的，他当时是联邦调查局反间谍部门的负责人，

sentences.en: which was running the whole Russia investigation.
sentences.zh: 该部门负责整个俄罗斯调查。

sentences.en: And this is January 24th, four days after the Trump administration takes over.
sentences.zh: 这是1月24日，在特朗普政府上任四天后。

sentences.en: And right before there is this decision to go send FBI agents to interview the national security advisor.
sentences.zh: 就在决定派遣联邦调查局特工讯问国家安全顾问之前。

sentences.en: And Priestap writes, quote, what's our goal?
sentences.zh: 普里斯特普写道，引用：我们的目标是什么？

sentences.en: Truth slash admission or to get him to lie so we can prosecute him or get him fired?
sentences.zh: 真相还是招供，或者是让他撒谎，以便我们起诉他或让他被解雇？

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: In another document, he seems to understand the risks of conducting this interview.
sentences.zh: 在另一份文件中，他似乎了解进行这次问话的风险。

sentences.en: And he says, protect our institution by not playing games.
sentences.zh: 他说，不要耍花招，以保护我们的机构。

sentences.en: And if we are seen playing games, the White House will be furious.
sentences.zh: 如果我们被发现耍花招，白宫会大发雷霆的。

sentences.en: Some of that language is quite potentially inflammatory.
sentences.zh: 其中一些措辞极具煽动性。

sentences.en: The idea that the person running the investigation is wondering if their goal might be to get the national security advisor fired, essentially to get him in trouble.
sentences.zh: 负责调查的人竟然在想，他们的目标是不是为了让国家安全顾问被解雇，本质上就是为了让他陷入麻烦。

sentences.en: It raises this question of whether Sidney Powell, Flynn's lawyers, had a point that they were trying to set him up, right?
sentences.zh: 这引出了一个问题：西德尼·鲍威尔（Sidney Powell）和弗林的律师们认为他们是在设局陷害他，这种说法是否有道理？

sentences.en: And finally, there's also interesting divide that is revealed between the FBI and the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 最后，联邦调查局（FBI）和司法部之间也显露出一种有趣的隔阂。

sentences.en: And what some of the documents show is that there was some concern of the Justice Department about what the FBI was up to.
sentences.zh: 一些文件显示，司法部对FBI的所作所为感到担忧。

sentences.en: So there's some concern about whether or not interviewing Flynn is at all a good idea.
sentences.zh: 所以，对于是否应该对弗林进行问话，他们存在一些顾虑。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we find out that the FBI only tells the Justice Department they're going to go do this while the agents are on their way to the White House.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，FBI直到探员们已经在去往白宫的路上时，才告诉司法部他们要去执行这项任务。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 呵。

sentences.en: Mark, what happens once these internal FBI documents are released?
sentences.zh: 马克，这些FBI内部文件公布后发生了什么？

sentences.en: What's the reaction?
sentences.zh: 外界有什么反应？

sentences.en: This unleashes a torrent of criticism.
sentences.zh: 这引发了一连串的批评。

sentences.en: He should dismiss the case for egregious government misconduct without a doubt.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，他应该以政府严重的渎职行为为由驳回此案。

sentences.en: By Flynn's lawyer, Sidney Powell.
sentences.zh: 这是弗林的律师西德尼·鲍威尔的观点。

sentences.en: That the government has been hiding this evidence that shows their own crimes while they were accusing Mr. Flynn faultfully of any crimes because they made it all up.
sentences.zh: 她说政府一直在隐瞒这些证据，这些证据显示了他们自己的罪行，而他们却在诬告弗林先生犯了罪，因为这一切都是他们编造的。

sentences.en: By other commentators on the right.
sentences.zh: 这是右翼评论员们的观点。

sentences.en: A lot of people close to this feel like Michael Flynn was set up, never lied.
sentences.zh: 许多了解内情的人觉得迈克尔·弗林是被陷害的，他从未撒谎。

sentences.en: He's admitting that they got things completely wrong and actively worked to defame someone.
sentences.zh: 他承认他们完全搞错了，并积极地试图诋毁某人。

sentences.en: Instead, it looks like two systems of justice in terms of how the FBI handled Hillary Clinton and how they handled Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 相反，在FBI处理希拉里·克林顿和唐纳德·特朗普的方式上，看起来像是存在两套司法系统。

sentences.en: By President Trump.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普总统的观点。

sentences.en: When I looked at what they did to him, they tormented him.
sentences.zh: 当我看到他们对他所做的一切时，他们折磨了他。

sentences.en: Dirty cups tormented General Flynn.
sentences.zh: 肮脏的手段折磨了弗林将军。

sentences.en: Making the case that Flynn should never have been interviewed and the case should now be dropped.
sentences.zh: 他们主张根本不应该对弗林进行问话，现在应该撤销此案。

sentences.en: And what would be the legal basis for that argument?
sentences.zh: 那么，这一论点的法律依据是什么？

sentences.en: What in the documents do Flynn's lawyers seize on and say makes his prosecution illegitimate?
sentences.zh: 弗林的律师们抓住了文件中的什么内容，并称这使得对他的起诉不合法？

sentences.en: Well, they're saying that these documents reveal that there was real concern in the FBI about whether the interview should have taken place in the first place.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们说这些文件显示，FBI内部对于当初是否应该进行那次问话确实存在真正的担忧。

sentences.en: And if the interview doesn't take place, then there's no lies to worry about.
sentences.zh: 如果问话没有发生，那么也就没有所谓的谎言需要担心了。

sentences.en: And if there's no lies, then there's nothing to prosecute Flynn on.
sentences.zh: 如果没有谎言，那么也就没有起诉弗林的理由了。

sentences.en: And therefore, there's no case, period.
sentences.zh: 因此，此案根本就不成立。

sentences.en: And Michael Flynn should walk free.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·弗林应该重获自由。

sentences.en: If you have no predicate to be there in the beginning, then whatever you find is immaterial to the investigation.
sentences.zh: 如果你一开始就没有调查的前提，那么你发现的任何东西对于调查来说都是无关紧要的。

sentences.en: And this is what Barr seizes on when he makes this incredibly dramatic decision last week.
sentences.zh: 这就是巴尔（Barr）在上周做出那个极其戏剧性的决定时所依据的逻辑。

sentences.en: Just then this afternoon, the Justice Department is dropping its criminal case against President Trump's former National Security Advisor, retired General Michael Flynn.
sentences.zh: 就在今天下午，司法部撤销了针对特朗普总统前国家安全顾问、退役将军迈克尔·弗林的刑事案件。

sentences.en: To drop the charges against Michael Flynn.
sentences.zh: 撤销对迈克尔·弗林的指控。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: The Justice Department today is holding that there was not a legitimate basis to do an investigation of Flynn.
sentences.zh: 司法部今天认定，对弗林进行调查并没有合法的依据。

sentences.en: Barr said there was never any good reason to interview Michael Flynn in the first place.
sentences.zh: 巴尔说，当初对迈克尔·弗林进行问话根本就没有正当理由。

sentences.en: And so whatever Flynn said during the interview was irrelevant.
sentences.zh: 所以弗林在问话期间说的任何话都无关紧要。

sentences.en: And Barr even goes further than that.
sentences.zh: 而且巴尔走得比这更远。

sentences.en: Attorney General Barr, thank you for speaking first to CBS News.
sentences.zh: 司法部长巴尔，感谢您首先接受哥伦比亚广播公司新闻部的采访。

sentences.en: Hi, Catherine.
sentences.zh: 你好，凯瑟琳。

sentences.en: In an interview last week, he not only criticizes the decisions that were made at the time to interview Flynn.
sentences.zh: 在上周的一次采访中，他不仅批评了当时决定对弗林进行问话的决定。

sentences.en: There was not, in our view, a legitimate investigation.
sentences.zh: 在我们看来，那根本不是一场合法的调查。

sentences.en: But he also goes to bat for Flynn going all the way back to Flynn's phone calls with the Russian ambassador.
sentences.zh: 而且他还为弗林辩护，一直追溯到弗林与俄罗斯大使的通话。

sentences.en: And it is very typical and very common for the national security team of the incoming president to communicate with foreign leaders.
sentences.zh: 即将上任的总统的国家安全团队与外国领导人进行沟通是非常典型且常见的。

sentences.en: And that call, there was nothing wrong with it, whatever.
sentences.zh: 那次通话没有任何问题，无论如何。

sentences.en: In fact, it was laudable.
sentences.zh: 事实上，那是值得称赞的。

sentences.en: And it was nothing inconsistent with the Obama administration's policies.
sentences.zh: 而且这与奥巴马政府的政策没有任何不一致之处。

sentences.en: And it was in U.S.
sentences.zh: 这符合美国的

sentences.en: intereSt.
sentences.zh: 利益。

sentences.en: He was saying to the Russians, you know, don't escalate.
sentences.zh: 他当时是在对俄罗斯人说，你知道，不要升级局势。

sentences.en: He actually says that the phone calls were laudable and that it was perfectly understandable that Flynn would talk to the Russian ambassador to try to lower tensions in a very tense environment.
sentences.zh: 他实际上说那些通话是值得称赞的，而且弗林为了试图缓和紧张局势而与俄罗斯大使交谈是完全可以理解的。

sentences.en: When history looks back on this decision, how do you think it will be written?
sentences.zh: 当历史回顾这一决定时，你认为它会被如何书写？

sentences.en: Well, history is written by the winner.
sentences.zh: 嗯，历史是由胜利者书写的。

sentences.en: So it largely depends on who's writing the history.
sentences.zh: 所以这很大程度上取决于谁在书写历史。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: what's fascinating about what Barr is doing is that it does not feel like every day when the Department of Justice sides with a defendant in a criminal prosecution over its own prosecutors who have successfully gone after that defendant.
sentences.zh: 巴尔的做法之所以引人注目，是因为司法部站在刑事被告一边，而不是站在成功起诉该被告的检察官一边，这在平时并不常见。

sentences.en: And it's in keeping with what William Barr has done for a year.
sentences.zh: 这与威廉·巴尔一年来的所作所为是一致的。

sentences.en: From the time that Robert Mueller presented his report to Barr, Barr has questioned the legitimacy of the investigation and any fruits of that investigation.
sentences.zh: 从罗伯特·穆勒向巴尔提交报告的那一刻起，巴尔就一直在质疑调查的合法性以及该调查的任何成果。

sentences.en: He has questioned whether those prosecuted were done so fairly or whether the FBI overreached.
sentences.zh: 他质疑被起诉的人是否受到了公正对待，或者FBI是否越权了。

sentences.en: He has also backed decisions to lower sentences of others.
sentences.zh: 他还支持了减轻他人刑期的决定。

sentences.en: I mean, Mark, is Barr's legal analysis in the Flynn case sound?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，马克，巴尔在弗林案中的法律分析合理吗？

sentences.en: Is it in dispute?
sentences.zh: 这有争议吗？

sentences.en: Barr's decision has been widely criticized.
sentences.zh: 巴尔的决定受到了广泛批评。

sentences.en: Plenty of legal experts say that prosecutors in general have wide discretion to decide which aspects of the investigation they want to pursue, what is germane to the case.
sentences.zh: 许多法律专家表示，检察官通常有广泛的自由裁量权来决定他们想要追求调查的哪些方面，以及什么与案件相关。

sentences.en: And in this specific instance,
sentences.zh: 而在这一特定案例中，

sentences.en: the fact that there was an ongoing investigation into contacts between Trump aides and the Russians would make Flynn's calls germane to this particular investigation.
sentences.zh: 针对特朗普助手与俄罗斯人之间联系的持续调查这一事实，会使弗林的通话与这一特定调查相关。

sentences.en: That is not to say that now looking back, there haven't been instances of FBI abuse over the course of the Russian investigation.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说现在回过头来看，在俄罗斯调查过程中没有出现过FBI滥用职权的情况。

sentences.en: Mark, given everything you've just said and reading these documents that have been released from the Department of Justice about the debate that went on inside the FBI,
sentences.zh: 马克，鉴于你刚才所说的一切，以及阅读了司法部公布的关于FBI内部辩论的文件，

sentences.en: these notes from an agent about how to conduct this interview, whether they might basically trap Flynn in a lie and get him fired.
sentences.zh: 这些来自探员的关于如何进行这次问话的笔记，关于他们是否可能基本上诱导弗林撒谎并让他被解雇。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: is there a version of this where what Bill Barr has done is exactly what any justice system should do when there are serious questions about the legitimacy of a prosecution,
sentences.zh: 是否存在这样一种情况：比尔·巴尔所做的事情，正是任何司法系统在对起诉的合法性存在严重质疑时应该做的事情，

sentences.en: which is kind of give the benefit of the doubt to the defendant?
sentences.zh: 也就是给被告以怀疑利益（即疑罪从无）？

sentences.en: You always want greater transparency when it comes to how an investigation was conducted.
sentences.zh: 当涉及到调查是如何进行的时候，你总是希望有更高的透明度。

sentences.en: That's true if the target is Michael Flynn or if the target is someone far less famous.
sentences.zh: 无论目标是迈克尔·弗林，还是一个远没那么出名的人，这都是事实。

sentences.en: The concern, of course, is whether there is abuse going on in the other direction.
sentences.zh: 当然，人们担心的是是否存在反方向的滥用职权。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: That what the attorney general is doing is, in effect, launching a campaign to discredit the investigation, to discredit the Mueller probe,
sentences.zh: 意思是司法部长实际上正在发起一场运动，旨在抹黑这项调查，抹黑穆勒调查，

sentences.en: to discredit its results in a way that will ultimately benefit his boss, President Trump.
sentences.zh: 以一种最终会使他的老板特朗普总统受益的方式来抹黑其结果。

sentences.en: Remember, President Trump, who's been railing against the quote-unquote witch hunt for years, will be using this for his re-election campaign.
sentences.zh: 记住，多年来一直抨击所谓“猎巫行动”的特朗普总统，将利用这一点进行他的连任竞选。

sentences.en: So the concern, of course, is that Bill Barr is kind of acting as a proxy warrior for the president.
sentences.zh: 所以，人们当然担心比尔·巴尔是在充当总统的代理人。

sentences.en: But, Mark, is it possible that both things can be true, that the attorney general, Bill Barr, may be trying to discredit the entire Russia investigation and, in the process,
sentences.zh: 但是，马克，有没有可能这两件事都是真的，即司法部长比尔·巴尔可能既在试图抹黑整个俄罗斯调查，并在过程中，

sentences.en: very much oversimplify things, and that the prosecution of Michael Flynn might be flawed?
sentences.zh: 非常过度地简化了事情，而对迈克尔·弗林的起诉也确实存在缺陷？

sentences.en: Yes, both of those things can be true.
sentences.zh: 是的，这两件事都可能是真的。

sentences.en: And this is why the passions are so intense on this issue, because both sides want to control the narrative, and because of that,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么在这个问题上人们的情绪如此强烈，因为双方都想控制叙事，正因如此，

sentences.en: can't allow necessarily any gray area in this argument.
sentences.zh: 在这个论点中不一定能容忍任何灰色地带。

sentences.en: Either Michael Flynn is a hero, or he's a traitor.
sentences.zh: 要么迈克尔·弗林是英雄，要么他是叛徒。

sentences.en: Either the Mueller investigation was a just pursuit, or it was a witch hunt.
sentences.zh: 要么穆勒调查是一次正义的追求，要么它是一场猎巫行动。

sentences.en: And, of course, there is a lot of space between those characterizations and nuance that gets lost because the political debate is black and white.
sentences.zh: 当然，在这些定性之间有很大的空间，而细微差别却因为政治辩论的非黑即白而丢失了。

sentences.en: So, Mark, what's going to happen to Michael Flynn now?
sentences.zh: 那么，马克，迈克尔·弗林现在会怎么样？

sentences.en: Well, of course, given what William Barr decided, there is a very likely scenario that Michael Flynn soon is a free man, and he is brought back into the fold.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当然，鉴于威廉·巴尔的决定，迈克尔·弗林很快就会成为自由人，并被重新接纳，这种可能性非常大。

sentences.en: And in the coming months, we see him, once again, campaigning for Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个月里，我们可能会再次看到他为唐纳德·特朗普竞选。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mark.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，马克。

sentences.en: Thanks, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Wednesday night, the Times reported that before the Department of Justice sought to throw out the case against Michael Flynn,
sentences.zh: 周三晚上，《泰晤士报》报道称，在司法部寻求撤销针对迈克尔·弗林的案件之前，

sentences.en: it had interviewed the FBI official, whose notes have been interpreted as potentially seeking to entrap Flynn.
sentences.zh: 它已经采访了那位FBI官员，其笔记被解读为可能试图诱导弗林。

sentences.en: In that interview, the official, Bill Priestap, said that his notes had been misconstrued and that there was no effort to set Flynn up.
sentences.zh: 在那次采访中，该官员比尔·普里斯特普（Bill Priestap）表示，他的笔记被曲解了，并没有设局陷害弗林的意图。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他事情。

sentences.en: The scope and speed of this downturn are without modern precedent, significantly worse than any recession since World War II.
sentences.zh: 这次经济衰退的范围和速度在现代史上没有先例，明显比二战以来的任何一次衰退都要严重。

sentences.en: In a speech on Wednesday, the chairman of the Federal Reserve warned that the pandemic could permanently damage the American economy
sentences.zh: 在周三的一次演讲中，美联储主席警告说，如果国会不采取行动防止破产潮和长期失业，

sentences.en: if Congress does not act to prevent a wave of bankruptcies and prolonged unemployment.
sentences.zh: 疫情可能会永久性地损害美国经济。

sentences.en: Long stretches of unemployment can damage or end workers' careers as their skills lose value and professional networks dry up and leave families in greater debt.
sentences.zh: 长期的失业会损害甚至终结工人的职业生涯，因为他们的技能会贬值，专业人脉会枯竭，并使家庭陷入更沉重的债务中。

sentences.en: The message from Jerome Powell suggested that the trillions of dollars that Congress has already pumped into the economy may not be enough.
sentences.zh: 杰罗姆·鲍威尔（Jerome Powell）传达的信息表明，国会已经投入经济的数万亿美元可能还不够。

sentences.en: Additional fiscal support could be costly, but worth it if it helps avoid long-term damage and leaves us with a stronger recovery.
sentences.zh: 额外的财政支持可能会付出高昂代价，但如果它有助于避免长期损害并使我们实现更强劲的复苏，那也是值得的。

sentences.en: And the House of Representatives is poised to temporarily change its rules to allow lawmakers to vote and hold committee hearings remotely
sentences.zh: 众议院准备暂时修改规则，允许议员们远程投票和举行委员会听证会，

sentences.en: so that they can avoid traveling to Washington during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这样他们就可以避免在疫情期间前往华盛顿。

sentences.en: The rules expected to pass tomorrow would mark a major change for a body long defined by the tradition of meeting and voting in person.
sentences.zh: 预计明天通过的规则将标志着一个长期以来以亲自开会和投票为传统的机构发生重大变革。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱，有时又令人激动的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·凯尼格（Sarah Koenig）主持的最新一期《地铁》（Metro）节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。
